generation_members.surface_form: MACE and grACE packages provide excellent scaling with number of elements while achieving high accuracy.
MACE-OFF3 uses only short-range interactions yet achieves improved performance on benchmark molecular simulation properties compared to ANI.
Orb performed 3-6 times faster than the pytorch version of MACE for large system sizes with dispersion corrections.
AIMNet2 targets molecular and macromolecular structures applicable to species containing up to 14 chemical elements in neutral and charged states.
ANI potential was expanded in 2020 to include S, Cl, and F elements, covering approximately 90% of drug-like molecules.
AIMNet2 extends ANI to include up to 14 elemental species with additional vdW and electrostatic correction terms.
